raw_segments.text: Ah, well, come forward, be seated here."
He drew a chair near his own.
"'I am not fond of the prattle of children,' he continued.
For old bachelor as I am I have no pleasant associations connected with their lisp.
It would be intolerable to me to pass a whole evening tare-tat-tare with a brat.
Don't draw that chair farther off, Miss Eyre.
Sit down exactly where I placed it, if you please, that is.
Nor do I particularly affect simple-minded old ladies.
By the by, I must have mine in mind.
It won't do to neglect her.
She is a Fairfax, or wed to one, and blood is said to be thicker than water."
